summary.text: Tip McGuire is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 64 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on May 13, 2019.

paragraphs.text: McGuire was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee, the Finance Committee, the Joint Finance Committee, the Joint Legislative Council Committee and the Joint Review Committee on Criminal Penalties for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
